text.en: This Order shall be cited as the Minor Offences Act 〔 Amendment) Order 2008 · Amendment of section 12 国 of Chapter 30 ·

Section 12 ( 1 ) of the Minor Offences Act, in this Order referred to as the principal Act, is amended by deleting " Municipal lnspector, lnspector of HeaIth a ny District Officer and any person authorised by him, the Director General of PubIic Works and a ny person authorised by him, and the Director of Environment, Par ks and Recreation and a ny person authorised by him" and by substituting "and any person authorised by the Minister by notification in the Gaze tte " therefor. Substitution of section 32A ·

Section 32A of the principal Act is repealed and the following new section substituted therefor t'Powers Of investigation. 32A · ln any case relating to the commission of an offence under this Act any person authorised by the Minister by notification in the Gaze tte shall have all the powers of a police officer under the Criminal Procedure Code (Chapter 7 ) in relation to an investigation into a seizable offence. ' 2529

BRUNEI DARUSSALAM GOVERNMENT GAZETTE Made this 28th. day of Syaaban , 1429 Hijriah corresponding to the 30th. day of August/ 2008 at Our lstana Nurul lmanr Bandar Seri Begawan, Brunei Darussalam.

HIS MAJESTY

THE SULTAN AND YANG DI-PERTUAN

BRUNEI DARUSSALAM 2530
